Alex (CS): Heads-up: BlueSparrow onboarding shows sustained p95 regressions on long-policy ingestion (OCR + multi-page receipts). Renewal check-in in 18 days. I'm proposing a proactive optimization: int4 pilot on a canary + split-route that sends very long docs to a compact-v3 with prefix caching for repeated headers. Want to sync on risk and rollout.
Mei (SE): Do we have concrete numbers to justify int4? Also curious about quality risk w/ int4 on extraction tasks.
Alex (CS): Metrics: baseline p50=90ms, p95=780ms, p99=1.6s. Ingest token blowup ~45% due to OCR verbosity; cost per request up ~30%. Business impact: onboarding flows time out for some users.
Tomas (Eng): Int4 gives ~25-35% latency win in our internal bench on long sequences but can affect numeric stability on span-extraction. I like split-route + prefix cache: we can cache the vendor header/footer tokens and only send body deltas.
Mei (SE): Proposed rollout: 1) small offline eval: 300 anonymized samples, compare EM/F1 against primary fp16 baseline; 2) if EM drop <=3%, run 7-day canary with 8% traffic to int4 primary + 12% to compact-v3 for >1400 tokens; 3) monitor per-route EM & latency.
Alex (CS): I'll ask BlueSparrow for eval consent and start extracting samples (PII redaction enabled). Renewal narrative: show expected cost reduction and latency improvement to reduce churn risk.
Tomas (Eng): Routing rule draft: ```json
{"conditions":[{"metric":"request.tokens.total","op":">","value":1400}],"primary_route":"primary-int4-v1","long_doc_route":"compact-v3-prefcache"}
``` 
We can also add a header-hash key for prefix cache: if header_hash matches cached entry, strip header tokens server-side.
Mei (SE): Can we add a confidence gate on compact-v3? If extraction.confidence < 0.7 then route fallback to primary-int4 for re-eval and attach both results for CS review. Also add a staged rollback trigger: quality delta >4% EM or p99 >1.4s.
Tomas (Eng): Yep, will implement fallback and a dual-call toggle. ops-bot: scheduling note?
ops-bot: Canary window available Tue 08:00-20:00 UTC for safe rollback within business hours.
Alex (CS): Good. Action items: Alex - request eval consent + collect 300 redacted samples (today), Mei - prepare eval harness and acceptance criteria (tomorrow AM), Tomas - implement split-route, prefix cache, and confidence-fallback with feature flags (48h).
Mei (SE): I'll include an evaluation notebook and a simple dashboard widget: per-route EM, F1, latency p50/p95/p99, and cost delta.
Tomas (Eng): Will instrument metrics and add alerts: route_quality_drop >=4% EM OR p99 >=1.4s -> auto-disable canary.
Alex (CS): Drafting customer note to highlight expected ~20% cost reduction and ~30% p95 improvement if canary passes. Will share before enabling.
Mei (SE): thumbs up.
Tomas (Eng): ack.
Alex (CS): Thanks all. Target: reduce p95 under 500ms and cut token cost by ~20% without >3% EM degradation. Will post a quick canary status update in 24h after start. :rocket:
